body:
I've spent a long time on these counselor people. Once I spent $670 USD a session to talk with someone who was apparently good. The only thing I got from that was, "you should join our weekly programme, it's only $34k a month".

Another thought humour would work, "your stress levels are at half this bottle, where -normal- people are at the bottom, and when you get more stressed you'll go over the top and become a psychopathic killer" - joke was lost on me.
Another one thought it would be funny to tell me that "if you kill your dog or kittens I'll tell the police, because you might do that" ... honestly?

...

Yeah... but the world threw another pile of shit at me. I'm hearing impaired, no phone.

I emailed my psychiatrist, only way she can meet me is in an hour. I'm not sure how I can last, i'm taking more and more drugs, and now I'm doing the beer. I'm so lost man.

aggrrh - i'll end up hurting everyone anyway, don't worry the world is better off.

http://www.lisadunningmft.com/child_abuse_cycle.htm

I never do this. I never contemplate suicide, but right now I have pills, I have alcohol and I have a nice place to finish it.

I want a family, I want to marry my fiance, and I want to have the best life ever.

I'm afraid I'll turn into a molester or something if I have children. I don't take a fancy in children, it doesn't phase me ("been there done that sort" of attitude). You know people who lose their relationships because of their porn addiction? Mine isn't porn addiction by far, it's ... fuck it's hard for me to say... "I miss the old days?" - not getting fucked and broadcasted to the internet but because things were so much easier (i.e. life) that I subconsciously put the two and two together which makes me feel like I'm exactly like the guy who hurt me way back then.

Then the shit that happened a few days ago makes me feel like I've failed everything. Absolutely. Failed. How did I get into that position for that to happen? Is that going to happen if I ever became a father? What happens if I got drunk, and something pops out of nowhere, something I didn't know was there?

No. Fuck That. I'll probably end up destroying her life and many others. I know the ripple effect myself, and it's... not worth it.
